limits: The RPC reply header selects only a bounded scheduler; it never grants callback authority.
The current protocol operation is not preempted. Ordinary work gets a turn after at most four priority holders when both classes wait.
Outgoing callback scheduling, durable owner recovery and production delegation handout remain open.
